criteria_outcomes.criterion: observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes support selected demand claims
generic keyword matches and unrelated candidates are excluded
missing or contradictory evidence remains visible

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand uses demand_score >= 3, which admits all eight supplied corpus rows, including low-scored and generic entries. The assigned job’s own final output only carries n06-r01 after downstream truncation, so the broad selection is masked later rather than justified by market-demand evidence.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve allowed corpus identifiers in a bounded normalized needs DataFrame
missing or contradictory evidence remains visible

reviews.decision_reason: normalize truncates the retained selected records to head(len([0])), reducing an eight-row selected demand set to one row. That hides missing and contradictory market-demand evidence and is the localized behavior that makes the upstream output contain only n06-r01.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: assemble ranked source provenance with missing-safe field access
preserve exact handoff content received from upstream normalized needs

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance receives the already-truncated normalized needs DataFrame and deterministically ranks that input with missing-safe field access. The one-row evidence_sources output matches the one-row needs input, so the significant fault is upstream of this boundary.
